title: Trick-or-Treaters
description: Children in all sorts of costumes stop Goolie. "Trick or treat!"

title: A Skeleton Dog
description: A skeleton dog wants some candy too. Goolie needs to find a treat it can safely eat.

title: The Hologram Ghost
description: Teenagers in white bedsheets rush over with a selfie stick. "Wow! This hologram ghost looks so real!"

title: A Bat in the Postal Cap
description: A lost bat, dizzy from the unusually hot October night, crashes into Goolie's postal cap.
safe_action: Fan the bat to cool it down
risk_action: Fan the bat to cool it down

title: Halloween Parade
description: A Halloween parade blocks the road ahead.
safe_action: Take a side path around the parade
risk_action: Take a side path around the parade

title: Erupting Geyser
description: A geyser erupts across the path ahead.
safe_action: Take a path around the geyser
risk_action: Take a path around the geyser

title: Sudden Fog
description: A sudden bank of thick fog swallows the road.

title: Ghost Hunters
description: Two human kids in cheap werewolf masks sweep the junction with bright flashlights on a ghost hunt.

title: Thawing Hillside
description: Geothermal heat loosens the frozen hillside. Warm mud and dead trees slide down and block the road.
safe_action: Take a side path around the mudslide
risk_action: Take a side path around the mudslide

title: A Sudden Gust
description: A sudden gust nearly blows the little ghost away!
safe_action: Fall back to the previous stop
risk_action: Fall back to the previous stop

title: Sulfur Steam
description: Scalding sulfur steam bursts from a crack in the ground. The heat leaves Goolie unable to see.
safe_action: Fall back from the hot spring steam
risk_action: Fall back from the hot spring steam

title: An Unexpected Float
description: A parade float turns into the street. Confetti and camera flashes rush straight at Goolie.
safe_action: Fall back from the human parade
risk_action: Fall back from the human parade
